text.description_html:
NGP 898N-36, 5 x 1/2 x 36 Half Saddle Threshold

5 inches wide x 1/2 inch high x 36 inches length ADA compliant half saddle threshold. These 36 inch long half saddle thresholds are made from non rusting T5 aluminum alloy and used for sealing the door bottom. ADA Compliant when installed with the non-beveled edge flush with flooring, or where no greater than 1/4 inch vertical rise occurs.

Field sizable, non-handed, mill finish Aluminum. Packaged with #10 x 1-1/2" flat head zinc plated wood screws. Fluted anti-slip top with typical wall thickness of .105".

Specifications for NGP 898N-36 36" Half Saddle Threshold:

  • Length: 36"
  • Width: 5"
  • Total Height: 1/2"
  • Wall Thickness: .105 (3/32")
  • Material: T5 aluminum alloy
  • Finish: Mill Finish Aluminum
  • TPV Seal: Black
  • Installation Screws: #10 x 1-1/2" FH Zinc Plated Wood Screws
  • ADA Compliant

*Sold Individually.
